title: Password Strength
summary: Compute a password score over distinct characters only: a lowercase English letter contributes one, uppercase two, a decimal digit three, and any of !@#$ five. Repeated occurrences of a character add nothing beyond its first contribution. Return the total.
officialConstraints: Length 1..100000; only English lowercase/uppercase letters, digits and !@#$ occur.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
